scenes.say: Here's the idea. Every day, a short video about tech, A.I. or money gets made and posted, and nobody edits it by hand.
scenes.caption: A Short a day, made and posted on its own.

scenes.say: It starts with a story. Frameflow finds one, checks the facts, writes the script in Habit's voice, then draws and voices every scene.
scenes.caption: Story, facts, script, drawn scenes, voice.

scenes.say: Then it checks its own work. Eleven automatic tests and a review against a quality bar, before anyone sees it.
scenes.caption: 11 automatic checks and a model review.

scenes.say: The owner gets one card on Telegram. Tap approve, and it posts at eleven thirty, on YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.
scenes.caption: One tap on Telegram. Posted at 11:30 on three platforms.

scenes.say: You can watch all of it in the Studio. Here's today's run. The stories it found. The one it picked. And when it posts.
scenes.caption: The Studio: today's run, live.

scenes.say: Open a video. You'll see every check it passed, how the reviewer scored it, and the whole script.
scenes.caption: Every check, every score, the full script.

scenes.say: And it learns. Every review, and every note, becomes a lesson that shapes the next video.
scenes.caption: Reviews and notes become lessons for the next video.

scenes.say: Have a look around. Today's run is live.
scenes.caption: Have a look. It's live.
